Otherwise it combines the log of volume, the complexity term, 16.2 * log(sloc) and 50 * sin(sqrt(2.46 * radians(comments))). Review points: (1) The comment percentage is computed at metrics.py:135-136 as (raw.comments + multi) / sloc * 100. The raw counts come from radon/raw.py, so the sloc, comment and multi-line-string classification there directly affects the score. (2) The sin(sqrt(2.46 * radians(pct))) term depends on the comment percentage staying in a sane range. Check the clamping and that the final result is normalized to 0-100. (3) Check that the complexity argument is the aggregate branch score produced by the visitors in radon/visitors.py. (4) The log guards cover volume and sloc but should be tested at boundary values.
